about: Settings files of frameworks that work while the game runs, by the name such a file must have, and how a line of one is laid out (TL01§23). ModTrap's data, not code. With it ModTrap says where in a line a plugin is named: as the thing the line gives or changes, as a condition for what the line reaches, or as an exclusion. 'layout' is 'pipes' for a line of the form key = first|more|more, where a condition can start with - (leave out), and conditions joined by + must all hold. What each framework does with a line that names a plugin which is not loaded is in the research note, with its source. Only frameworks whose handling of a missing plugin was read in their source are listed; a file of any other kind is left to the owner.
